# Which roles answer the size of content at each option?

Read this when your style plugin answers the size of a part that is content rather than a control, at one size option.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Only Arena's components read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-lg-avatar` | How wide is an avatar at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-caption-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list rank and secondary line at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-lg-face` | How wide is the face in a people-list row at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-figure-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list figure at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-lg-list-gap` | How far apart are people-list rows at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-logo-mark` | How big is the logo mark at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-logo-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets the logo wordmark at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-name-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list name at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-lg-rank` | How wide is a people-list rank at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-row-gap` | How far apart are the parts of a people-list row at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-row-pad-x` | How much side padding does a people-list row have at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-row-pad-y` | How much top and bottom padding does a people-list row have at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-avatar` | How wide is an avatar at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-caption-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list rank and secondary line at the md size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-md-face` | How wide is the face in a people-list row at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-figure-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list figure at the md size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-md-list-gap` | How far apart are people-list rows at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-logo-mark` | How big is the logo mark at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-logo-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets the logo wordmark at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-name-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list name at the md size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-md-rank` | How wide is a people-list rank at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-row-gap` | How far apart are the parts of a people-list row at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-row-pad-x` | How much side padding does a people-list row have at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-row-pad-y` | How much top and bottom padding does a people-list row have at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-sm-avatar` | How wide is an avatar at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-sm-badge-pad-x` | How much side padding does a badge have at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | `{sp.1}` |
| `--size-sm-badge-pad-y` | How much top and bottom padding does a badge have at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | `{sp.0}` |
| `--size-sm-badge-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a badge label at the sm size? | dimension | scales | `{dz.text-2xs}` |
| `--size-sm-caption-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list rank and secondary line at the sm size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-sm-face` | How wide is the face in a people-list row at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-sm-figure-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list figure at the sm size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-sm-list-gap` | How far apart are people-list rows at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-sm-logo-mark` | How big is the logo mark at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
